Subject: Claim-or-Archive: 7-day ownership window for dormant opps

Team,

Finance is finishing the monthly forecast reconciliation and a number of open opportunities are showing no owner activity in SFDC for 60+ days. We need to reduce noise in the commit and lock the forecast. Please take the following actions for opps assigned to you listed in the attached CSV: 

- Claim: If you are actively working the deal, reply to this thread with the expected next milestone and update the SFDC stage + close date by EOD 5/24.
- Archive / Move to Nurture: If there is no real engagement or the opportunity is ghosted, please change the opportunity to Closed - Lost (or move to Nurture) and leave a one-line reason in the Comments.

I attached a filtered export (Q2_pipeline_handoff.csv) and added a short Drive sheet with owner suggestions. Finance will exclude unclaimed deals from the committed number after 5/24. If you need me to reassign an opportunity, flag it here and I will coordinate.

Quick ask: claim or archive within 7 days. Small actions here have an outsized impact on our forecast accuracy.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Senior AM, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
